title.zh: Coinbase 数据泄露争议：公司否认，慢雾确认用户联系方式泄露
title.en: ⚡️慢雾：Coinbase数据泄露属实，尚未确认密码或资金是否被盗

current_state.zh: Coinbase 否认发生数据泄露，将安全问题归咎于第三方分析服务提供商 Amplitude。
current_state.en: Coinbase denied suffering a data breach, attributing the security issue to a third-party analytics provider, Amplitude.

updates.what_changed_zh: SlowMist 确认 Coinbase 数据泄露暴露了超过 70,000 名用户的联系信息，但尚未确认密码或资金被盗。
updates.what_changed_en: SlowMist confirmed that a Coinbase data breach exposed contact information for over 70,000 users, while theft of passwords or funds has not been confirmed.
